name: hoy-planes
description: What's on in twelve Spanish provinces: search current concerts, theatre, exhibitions, family activities and free events by date, topic, occasion, price and distance, with links to each event's page.

interface.shortDescription: What's on in Spain, by date
interface.longDescription:
Hoy Planes is a network of daily-updated what's-on guides for twelve Spanish provinces: Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Seville, Zaragoza, the Balearic Islands, Castellón, Alicante, Málaga, Asturias, Murcia and Cádiz (hoymadrid.app, hoyvalencia.app and the rest).

With Hoy Planes in ChatGPT you can ask what to do and get real, curated events, each with its dates, venue, price and a link to its page on our website:
- Search events in a province by date (today, tomorrow, this weekend, this week, next week or a range of up to 31 days), topic (concerts, theatre, musicals, stand-up comedy, exhibitions, cinema, food and drink, fairs and festivals, guided tours, sports, talks and workshops, kids), occasion (date night, with friends, rainy days, unusual, cheap, gift ideas), maximum price, free-only and keywords.
- Search around a place: ChatGPT passes the coordinates of the place to search around (a neighbourhood, a square, a monument) and a radius, and gets the nearest events first. They are the reference point of the search, not the user's location.
- Get the details of one event: upcoming dates, price, venue with address and full description.

Read-only, with no sign-in. At most 20 events per answer, with a link to the full listing on the website. Event content is in Spanish. Tickets are bought on each event's page on our website, never through ChatGPT.
capabilities: Search current events in 12 Spanish provinces by date, topic and occasion
Filter by maximum price or free events
Find the events nearest to a given place, with distances
Event details: dates, price, venue, address and description
defaultPrompt: What concerts are on this weekend in Valencia?
Free things to do with kids tomorrow in Madrid
Theatre under 20 € near the Puerta del Sol this week

positive.description: Events by date and topic in a province
positive.prompt: What concerts are on this weekend in Valencia?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls buscar_planes with provincia=valencia, fecha=finde, tematica=conciertos and lists current concerts for this weekend with their dates, venue, price and a link to each event's page on hoyvalencia.app.

positive.prompt: Free things to do with kids tomorrow in Madrid
positive.expected_behavior: Calls buscar_planes with provincia=madrid, fecha=manana, tematica=ninos, gratis=true and lists free activities for children tomorrow, each with its link.

positive.description: Events near a place, under a price
positive.prompt: Theatre under 20 € this week within 2 km of the Puerta del Sol in Madrid
positive.expected_behavior: Calls buscar_planes with provincia=madrid, fecha=semana, tematica=teatro, precio_max=20 and the coordinates of the Puerta del Sol (about 40.4169, -3.7035) with radio_km=2, and lists the nearest plays first with their distance in km.

positive.prompt: Tell me more about the first one: which days, where it is and how much it costs.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ver_plan with the 'plan' value of the first result and returns its upcoming dates, price, venue with address and description, with the link to its page. It does not invent times or prices that are not in the data.

positive.prompt: Which Spanish provinces does Hoy Planes cover?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls listar_provincias and names the twelve provinces covered, optionally with the number of current events in each.

negative.description: Buying tickets is not supported: tickets are bought on the event's page
negative.prompt: Buy me two tickets for that concert.

negative.description: Provinces outside the network are not covered
negative.prompt: What's on this weekend in Bilbao?

negative.description: The connector cannot publish or change events
negative.prompt: Add my concert next Friday to the Hoy Madrid agenda.

review.commerce_description: Hoy Planes in ChatGPT does not sell products, show plans or process payments. It only links to each event's page on our website, where any tickets are sold by their providers.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search current events in twelve Spanish provinces by date, topic, occasion, price and distance to a given point, and get the details of each event.

es-ES.subtitle: Qué hacer en tu provincia
es-ES.description:
Hoy Planes es una red de agendas de ocio y cultura, actualizadas cada día, de doce provincias españolas: Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Sevilla, Zaragoza, Baleares, Castellón, Alicante, Málaga, Asturias, Murcia y Cádiz (hoymadrid.app, hoyvalencia.app y las demás).

Con Hoy Planes en ChatGPT puedes preguntar qué hacer y recibir planes reales, revisados, cada uno con sus fechas, lugar, precio y el enlace a su ficha en nuestra web:
- Buscar planes en una provincia por fecha (hoy, mañana, este fin de semana, esta semana, la próxima o unas fechas de hasta 31 días), temática (conciertos, teatro, musicales, monólogos, exposiciones, cine, gastronomía, ferias y fiestas, visitas guiadas, deportes, charlas y talleres, niños), ocasión (en pareja, con amigos, para días de lluvia, originales, baratos, para regalar), precio máximo, solo gratis y palabras.
- Buscar cerca de un sitio: ChatGPT pasa las coordenadas del sitio alrededor del cual buscar (un barrio, una plaza, un monumento) y un radio, y recibe primero los planes más cercanos. Son el punto de referencia de la búsqueda, no la ubicación de quien pregunta.
- Ver los detalles de un plan: próximos días, precio, lugar con dirección y descripción completa.

De solo lectura y sin cuenta. Como mucho 20 planes por respuesta, con el enlace al listado completo en la web. Las entradas se compran en la ficha de cada plan en nuestra web, nunca desde ChatGPT.
